messages.author: b3f6c132c4206fae
messages.subject: geom_bar and legend challenges
parts:
Hi everyone,

My goal is to show the difference in magnitude of two time series at
each point in time. What I did is to overlay one geom_bar plot on top
of another, using color and level of transparency to separate two
series.

My biggest question is how do I create a proper legend to indicate
"who's who"? As you see the result of my code, the legend seems to be
messed up by my "alpha" setting...

Also, is there a simpler way (one-step) to get to the same plot?

The reproducible code follows.
#=========================================
dates <- seq(from = as.Date(head(lead.lag.ret$Date, 1)),
to = as.Date(tail(lead.lag.ret$Date, 1)),
by = "year"
)
df <- data.frame(
Date = as.character(dates),
A = rnorm(length(dates)),
B = rnorm(length(dates))
)

p <- ggplot(data = df) +
geom_bar(aes(x = Date, y = A, alpha = 0.5))

p <- p + geom_bar(aes(x = Date, y = B, fill = "red", alpha = 0.5))
p
#=========================================

Any feedback is appreciated. Thanks.
Stanley

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: geom_bar and legend challenges
parts:
I suspect you want:

ggplot(data = df) +
geom_bar(aes(x = Date, y = A), alpha = 0.5) +
geom_bar(aes(x = Date, y = B), fill = "red", alpha = 0.5)

Note that the alpha and fill colour do not need to be scaled, so they
are outside the aesthetic mapping.

Hadley

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: geom_bar and legend challenges
parts:
Hi Stanley,

If you want a legend, then:

ggplot(data = df) +
geom_bar(aes(x = Date, y = A, fill = "positive")) +
geom_bar(aes(x = Date, y = B, fill = "negative")) +
scale_fill_manual("Direction", values =
c("positive" = alpha("black", 0.5), "negative" = alpha("red", 0.5)))

Hadley

messages.author: 3033a60610caec0b
messages.subject: Re: geom_bar and legend challenges
parts:
Or, incorporating "melt", and making the ggplot call simpler:

dfm <- melt(
df,
id.vars = "Date",
variable_name = "Entity"
)

ggplot(data = dfm) +
geom_bar(
aes(x = Date, y = value, fill = Entity),
alpha = 0.5,
position = "identity"
)
